programs.title: Health Class
programs.description: Personal hygiene, nutrition, disease prevention, and mental-health instruction from the Internet Archive's Prelinger Archives -- the classroom health unit, decade by decade, from germ theory to "keeping mentally fit."

programs.title: Civics Hour
programs.description: American history, government, and civic life from the Internet Archive's Prelinger Archives -- the Bill of Rights, Congress, World's Fairs, wartime homefront propaganda, and the project of building postwar America.

programs.title: Science Shorts
programs.description: Natural science and classroom physics from the Internet Archive's Prelinger Archives -- sound, light, color, electricity, and the small creatures (and smaller atoms) a mid-century science class might cover.

programs.title: The Working World
programs.description: Vocational-guidance and industrial-process films from the Internet Archive's Prelinger Archives -- trades, careers, factories, and the consumer economics of banking, money, and meat, as taught to generations of American students.

programs.title: Mind Your Manners
programs.description: Teenage social-guidance films from the Internet Archive's Prelinger Archives: dating, grooming, popularity, honesty, and the agony of adolescence as mid-century classroom-film producers imagined it.

programs.title: Safety First
programs.description: Civil-defense drills, "scared straight" crime dramas, and workplace/traffic safety shorts from the Internet Archive's Prelinger Archives -- duck-and-cover atomic preparedness, juvenile-delinquency cautionary tales, and everyday hazard-avoidance films shown to generations of American schoolchildren.

programs.title: Wired World
programs.description: Telephone, radio, television, and the first computers, from the Internet Archive's Prelinger Archives -- how 20th-century America talked, broadcast, and began to compute.

programs.title: On the Move
programs.description: Roads, railroads, airports, and the infrastructure of getting around, from the Internet Archive's Prelinger Archives -- mid-century America in transit.

programs.title: Marriage & the Office
programs.description: Social-guidance films for grown-ups from the Internet Archive's Prelinger Archives -- marriage, housework, office etiquette, and the workplace politics of mid-century American domestic and clerical life.
